title: Continuity and exact sheaf pullbacks for finite coverings
statement: Continuous functors p:A→C, U:C→D and e:D→B whose constructed sheaf pullbacks on sets preserve finite limits and finite colimits have the same exactness after composing. Any continuous T:A→B naturally isomorphic to (p followed by U) followed by e therefore has exact sheaf pullback. The module also proves continuity from preservation of finite covering families and their pullbacks, and proves exactness of the evaluation and section equivalences for the finite transported precoverage [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage].

source.place: Situation 0A34, Lemmas 00WW, 00WX and 03CB; finite-family covering axioms of 00VH

proof.text: For continuity present a finite covering presieve by its distinct arrows, apply finite indexed base change, and apply the pairwise-pullback sheaf criterion. For evaluation and its section these criteria give continuity both ways. Their unit and counit induce inverse pushforwards on sheaves; an adjoint of an equivalence is an equivalence, hence preserves limits, and the left adjoint preserves colimits. For composition compose adjunctions, identify the right adjoints via the pushforward composition isomorphism, and use uniqueness of left adjoints. The natural isomorphism T ≅ (p⋙U)⋙e gives an isomorphism of right adjoints; uniqueness again transfers exactness.

proof_origin.place: W4: finite-cover continuity generalized to independent object and hom universes. Equivalence transport uses only finite composition and finite base change; the exact sheaf-pullback API and coefficient universe of the other declarations stay unchanged.
